integrity: Proof includes explicit rational root-isolation and Descartes peak-count certificate; two standalone scripts verify finite moment comparisons and symbolic identities. Numerical experiments are not substituted for the infinite proof. No independent mathematical audit performed.
scientific_limitations: The finite covariance spectrum is exact by a five-state matrix formula; asymptotic, not finite, extreme-index classification is claimed. Uniform, unweighted domination on cycle squares only. General renewal spectral transforms and cardinality recurrences are prior art. Historical priority of the specialized peak classification is provisional.
title: Two-peak Fourier conditioning of dominating sets on square cycles
